evidence.quote: We have 2 entrances/exits – one is located on Holywell Lane and has a couple of steps, the other is located on Great Eastern Street and is fully accessible.
We have one dedicated accessible toilet. This is located at the front of the building next to the cloakroom area.
We recognise that for many people there are barriers that can sometimes make it difficult to enjoy live music and culture.

findings.value: A raised, ramp-access viewing platform at the back suits wheelchair users and people who need a seat. Access tickets (seated or wheelchair plus carer) are sold only on DICE. There is no accessible bar, but staff will serve someone without a carer. Strobe lighting is used on some shows. Email the venue for a free companion entry or other access questions.

evidence.quote: For all music events there is a raised platform at the back of the venue for wheelchair users and those who need to be seated.
Seated/Wheelchair + Carer Tickets are only available to purchase on Dice.
We do not have an accessible bar however we can provide a bartender if a customer is without a carer.
We do use strobe and flashing lighting in the venue on some shows
We also allow free entry for a companion if you require this

findings.value: Live music 16+, with 16 and 17-year-olds accompanied by one adult; club nights 18+.

evidence.quote: Live music events are strictly over 16 and each 16-17 year old under 18 must be accompanied by one responsible adult
Any Club night is strictly over 18 and right of admission will be reserved.

findings.value: Fully cashless: card or contactless only. Its own tickets are sold via DICE.

evidence.quote: Our venue is now 100% cashless. All payments must be made by card or contactless methods.
VU’s ticket allocation is sold through Dice.
